name: Pipedream
summary: Pipedream runs one hosted MCP server for over 3,000 APIs. Google Search Console is one of them, with 8 actions.
signIn: Add Pipedream's server URL to the AI client, authorize a Pipedream account, then connect the Google Search Console account.
tools: 8 actions available as tools, stated on the Google Search Console MCP page.
dataSources: Google Search Console search analytics, single range and two range comparison
Google Search Console URL inspection (1 to 10 URLs per call)
Google Search Console sites and sitemaps
Google Indexing API (JobPosting and BroadcastEvent pages only)
free: Pipedream's MCP page says the tools can be added to an AI assistant for free. The Pipedream Free plan is $0 with every feature in development only.
price: Free $0. Startup $99 per month billed annually or $150 per month billed monthly, with 100 users and 10,000 usage credits, then $2 per user and $0.012 per credit. Business custom. Prices in USD. These plans are for Pipedream Connect, which serves external users in production.
freeShort: Free to add to an AI assistant
priceFrom: $99 a month for Connect, billed yearly
writeActions: Yes. Submit Sitemap, Delete Sitemap, and Submit URL for Indexing through the Indexing API.
dataStorage: Credentials are encrypted at rest and scoped per project. Storage of query results is not stated.
licence: Hosted service. The Google Search Console component source is in PipedreamHQ/pipedream under the Pipedream Source Available License 1.0.
pickIf: You already build on Pipedream and want Search Console in the same toolbox.
You want your agent to submit and delete sitemaps and send Indexing API notifications.
You want the tool code to be public on GitHub.
